subject: Request: Executive sanction for 35% Hosted API concession — Moleculix pilot
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Executive sanction for 35% Hosted API concession — Moleculix pilot

Team —

Quick ask: Moleculix (see contacts below) are asking for a 35% concession on Hosted API list pricing for a time-boxed 3-month pilot. This exceeds our standard approval band (>20% requires exec sanction).

Why we should consider:
- They are a high-growth genomics SaaS company targeting a multi-region launch in Q1; they plan to go into production on Redwood if pilot metrics hit thresholds.
- Forecasted hosted consumption during pilot: ~1.2B tokens/month; they’ve signaled a 12–18 month post-pilot commit if performance/lift is good.
- Strategic value: references to several regional partners already lining up to resell their product — potential for a multi-year, multi-region ARR.

I’ve attached a short deal summary and the latest SOW redline. Key asks: 35% off list + a capped monthly spend during the pilot (to limit risk). Proposed mitigations: limited pilot capacity, telemetry hooks, automatic rate-limit revert if usage spikes beyond forecast.

Can I get exec sanction to approve 35% for this pilot, with the conditions above and a timeout (pilot auto-reverts to standard pricing after 90 days unless we sign a follow-on agreement)? If approved I will finalize SOW and send to Moleculix.

Attachments: moleculix-deal-summary-0826.pdf, sow_redline_v3.docx

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter | Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0172
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Executive sanction for 35% Hosted API concession — Moleculix pilot

Ben — thanks for the summary and attachments. A couple quick clarifying questions before I escalate for formal signoff:
1) What is the expected gross margin impact at 35% for the pilot (token unit economics)?
2) What is the likelihood (low/med/high) they convert to an annualized commitment post-pilot and what ARR do we expect in the best/worst case?
3) Is Moleculix requesting any other non-standard terms (data residency, long-term SLAs, IP)?

If you can reply with those numbers (and a short recommendation on whether we can stage the concession — e.g., start at 35% for the first month, 25% for month 2, review month 3) I’ll route to CFO/legal for quick look and flag to execs.

- Marissa
Marissa Cole | VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Executive sanction for 35% Hosted API concession — Moleculix pilot

Marissa — answers below and updated attachment with a simple 3-month staging option.

1) Margin impact: at projected usage (~1.2B tokens/mo) and current cost profile, 35% off list would reduce gross margin on pilot traffic to ~24% (from baseline ~44%). We’ve modelled a capped spend of $85k/mo during pilot which limits downside.
2) Conversion likelihood: MED-HIGH. Moleculix leadership indicated a 12–18 month commit if pilot metrics meet latency and cost targets. Best case ARR (12 months) ~ $1.2M; conservative case (no commit) $0.
3) Non-standard terms: they asked for EU data residency for a subset of traffic (partner-managed), but that would be handled post-pilot with our Private/Dedicated offering. No IP claims or unusual SLA demands for the pilot.

Recommendation: Approve a staged concession: 35% month 1, 30% month 2, 25% month 3 + conditional 12-month pricing discussion if they commit before pilot end. Keep pilot capped at $85k/mo and include telemetry/rollback clause.

I’ve attached an updated deal-summary (page 2 contains the staging).

Ben
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Executive sanction for 35% Hosted API concession — Moleculix pilot

Thanks for the detail, Ben. My take: the strategic upside seems real but we should tighten conditions. I recommend we:
- Approve up to 30% full concession; any ask beyond 30% (i.e., 35%) should require explicit exec signoff with documented ROI assumptions.
- Ensure the pilot has an automatic pricing reversion and a hard cap on monthly spend (you already have $85k).
- Require a short post-pilot business-review checkpoint with finance to confirm unit economics before any extension.

If Marissa/execs want to approve 35% for month 1 as a true test with an immediate review, I can support.

Karthik
Senior Director, Deal Desk — Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Executive sanction for 35% Hosted API concession — Moleculix pilot

Marissa — pinging you for exec sanction here. Given the potential ARR and the mitigations (cap + rollback + staged pricing), I support Ben’s recommendation to allow the staged approach.

Ben: please confirm the contract language includes the automatic revert and a clause that any post-pilot rate below list requires a signed enterprise commitment. I’ll also notify partnerships about potential reseller interest.

Jordan
Head of Sales — Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, cc: legal@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Executive sanction for 35% Hosted API concession — Moleculix pilot

Approved: executive sanction granted for the staged concession as proposed. Conditions: 1) Pilot capped at $85k/month; 2) Pricing automatically reverts to list after 90 days unless a signed follow-on agreement is in place; 3) Finance to review unit economics at the 30-day checkpoint and sign off on any continuation; 4) Legal to confirm the rollback clause language in the SOW.

Ben — you have executive sanction to proceed. Please circulate the final SOW and DocuSign link once the legal redlines are in.

Marissa Cole
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
